name: Ichiba Monozukuri
description: Ichiba Monozukuri — a monthly craft market theme laid out like a printed market magazine: a masthead top bar with the market name, a horizontal menu and a Visit button. Ai indigo (#165E83) is the main colour: the hero, every page head and the season band are indigo fields with white type. The hero is a stacked collage of two risograph prints (stalls under awnings, hands carving a spoon) with a cut-out still life of a teapot, basket and indigo cloth breaking out of the collage and over the hero edge; a cut-out bowl breaks over the market-day band. Every picture is a two-ink risograph illustration (indigo and vermilion, halftone grain, slight misregistration). Train One for display, Hanken Grotesk for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-23 (editorial-magazine, stacked-collage hero, top-bar nav, cutout-break-frame, risograph, ai indigo #165E83, Train One + Hanken Grotesk). A full masthead top bar (market name, horizontal menu, Apply for a stall button; overlay menu on small screens). Sections open like magazine pages with numbered heads on a thick rule and two-column text. Every picture is a two-ink risograph illustration generated with Grok Build (indigo and vermilion, halftone grain); break-frame: a transparent cut-out still life (teapot, basket, indigo cloth) breaks out of the stacked hero collage and over the hero edge, and a cut-out bowl breaks over the market-day band. Sample content in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de; vertical text only in Chinese and Japanese. Contrast: white #FFFFFF on ai indigo #165E83 7.1:1 (all text on the hero, page heads and season band); paper #F2F6F9 on ai indigo 6.5:1; night #0D2738 on paper #F2F6F9 14.2:1; deep indigo #13506F on paper 8.0:1 (links, labels); slate #46555F on paper 7.1:1 (secondary text); sky #A9D3EC on night 9.7:1 (labels on the board and market-day band); night on riso vermilion #F08A6E 6.3:1 (buttons, collage label); night on pale indigo #D9E8F1 12.3:1; vermilion on ai indigo only 2.9:1 and night on ai indigo 2.2:1, never used for text.

summary.zh-TW: 藍色的每月手作市集：雜誌式版面、橫向頂部選單、孔版印刷風插畫堆疊拼貼主視覺，去背茶壺與竹籃衝出畫框；樣本內容含五種語言。
summary.en: An indigo monthly craft market laid out like a magazine: a top-bar menu, a stacked risograph collage and a cut-out still life breaking out.
summary.ja: 藍色の月例クラフト市。雑誌のような誌面、横並びのトップバー、リソグラフ風イラストの重ね貼りから飛び出す切り抜きの急須。五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Un marché artisanal indigo mis en page comme un magazine : menu en barre, collage risographie et nature morte détourée qui déborde.
summary.de: Ein indigoblauer Handwerksmarkt im Magazin-Layout: Menüleiste oben, Risographie-Collage und ein Stillleben-Freisteller, der herausragt.
